findings.text: correctness lens, medium: The JSON holder extraction in `zbuild_claim_acquire` uses `grep -o '"holder":[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"'`; the `[^"]*` class stops at the first `"` character, so a holder whose JSON-escaped form contains `\"` (an escaped double-quote, written by `claim_coordinator_claim`'s `sed 's/"/\\"/g'`) is silently truncated — the regex matches only the bytes before the escaped quote. (core/claim/claim.sh: "raw_holder="$(grep -o '"holder":[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' <<< "$json_out" || true)""; happens when: A holder string containing a literal double-quote character (e.g. a machine name or run-id containing `"`); `claim_coordinator_claim` JSON-escapes it to `\"`, but `[^"]*` stops at the unescaped `"` byte, returning a truncated `raw_holder` to the outer `sed` extraction, which then strips only up to the first `"` it sees.; fix: code; ACCEPTED IF: The holder string as printed in the run's refusal output is identical to the holder string embedded in the run-status comment's `<!-- zbuild-holder: -->` field, even when that string contains a double-quote character.)
